title: Chapter 15: Fictitious Transactions
paragraphs: "Sir, if the information is correct, I'll affix my professional seal now. Remember our website: sto55.com."

Inside the shop, Wu Wan handed Chen Mobai the stiff card certificate filled with the Magic Tool owner's information for verification. He then solemnly opened a safe, retrieved a crimson seal, and without needing ink, pressed it directly onto the certificate. A vermilion, oval-shaped First-Tier Artifact Appraiser's seal appeared on the document.
At the center of the seal was Wu Wan's name in regular script, with "First-Tier Artifact Appraiser" inscribed in a semi-circle above and a series of numerical symbols arranged in a semi-circle below.

"This string of symbols is a randomly generated anti-counterfeiting code produced each time the seal is applied. After I upload this certificate to the Immortal Sect Network, anyone who enters this code will be able to view the certificate."
Chen Mobai took the Needle Case and certificate, immediately using his phone to check the Immortal Sect Network. To his surprise, the page that loaded was completely blank, leaving him puzzled.
"Hasn't it been uploaded yet?"
Wu Wan chuckled wryly but promptly logged into the Artifact Appraiser's electronic archive on the Immortal Sect Network using his account and uploaded the Needle Case's certificate.
Chen Mobai tried again, and this time the corresponding page finally appeared.
"Thank you for your hard work, Master Wu."
After paying the 200 Merit Points with satisfaction, Chen Mobai accepted the Needle Case.

"Young Chen, if you're looking to sell this Magic Tool, you can list it in my shop. It would help me accumulate some Points. If you agree, I'll not only refund your Merit Points, but I'll even complete the Refining and Usage Art for this Magic Tool free of charge."

While filling out the Magic Tool's owner information earlier, Wu Wan had learned Chen Mobai's name. Discovering that he was just an eighteen-year-old student with little social experience, an idea suddenly struck him.

In the Immortal Sect, due to the scarcity of resources, almost every cultivator, after embarking on the path of Cultivation, would struggle with Spiritual Energy and material needs. Many of them would rely on the Immortal Sect Network, opening personal online shops to earn money.

Although Wu Wan had earned his First-Tier Artifact Appraiser certificate and was considered a prominent figure among Qi Refinement cultivators, he was still scrambling for the resources needed to achieve Foundation Establishment.
Besides his ancestral shop, he also practiced artifact refining in his spare time.
After all, being an Artifact Appraiser didn't bring great wealth, and every cultivator who studied artifact appraisal initially aspired to become an Artifact Refiner.

Personal shops on the Immortal Sect Network operated on a system of accumulating Points through Merit Points earned from buying and selling. The more Points accumulated, the more official Profound Arts and Secret Techniques, Spiritual Pills, and Magic Tools could be redeemed.

The Immortal Sect ruled Diyuan Star and upheld the order inherited from the previous civilization. Despite the Soul Transformation Patriarchs suppressing heaven and earth, economic crises still erupted repeatedly.

The primary issue was a persistent shortage of Spirit Stones. During periods of war and expansion, cultivators would immediately exchange any Merit Points in their accounts for Spirit Stones, even hoarding them for future generations if they couldn't use them all themselves.
This constant rush to exchange Merit Points overwhelmed the National Bank's Spirit Stone reserves, no matter how vast they were, triggering economic crises.

The Immortal Sect responded with a series of edicts, including bans on Spirit Stone exchanges, inflated exchange rates, and even secret techniques to replenish depleted Spirit Stones with Spiritual Energy. However, even the Soul Transformation Patriarchs, with their heaven-defying power, couldn't override the fundamental laws of market economics.
Over millennia, the Three Halls and Four Ministries of the Immortal Sect had gathered countless geniuses from Diyuan Star, attracting countless individuals of unparalleled intellect.

A thousand years ago, someone proposed opening the Immortal Sect National Library's collection of eighty-four thousand Daoist Scriptures, allowing all cultivators to redeem them freely using Points. These Points, in turn, could only be obtained by spending Merit Points on the Immortal Sect's marketplace.
For example, when Chen Mobai purchased three Azure Arrow Talismans online for 105 Merit Points, his personal account automatically gained 105 Points.

This policy instantly revitalized the Immortal Sect's stagnant market economy. Within just a decade, ninety percent of the Spirit Stones hoarded by the populace flowed back into the National Bank, replaced by Merit Points in individual accounts.
Offline transactions could also earn Points, but both the buyer and seller had to pay taxes to the Immortal Sect Tax Bureau.
After all, only consumption earned Points; receiving payment did not.
Therefore, on the Immortal Sect's market, traders always confirmed whether customers wanted to earn Points before the transaction, adding the tax to the total price upfront if necessary.
Precisely for this reason, the Immortal Sect doesn't compel tax payment; it's entirely voluntary.
But Chen Mobai was clearly not the type to volunteer. He hadn't yet reached the point where he needed Points.
"Master Wu, what exactly do you mean by that? I don't understand."
Chen Mobai was puzzled.Only consumers earn Points,he thought.Even if my Magic Tool sells in Wu Wan's shop, it has nothing to do with him, right?

"As an Artifact Appraiser, earning money through my expertise is perfectly normal. If you sell this Magic Tool to me, and I use my professional knowledge to complete the Needle Case's Refining and Usage Art, its resale price would naturally double. Am I correct?" Wu Wan said with a smile.
Chen Mobai shivered, a chill running down his spine.
"Master Wu, this would be a fictitious transaction—illegal."
For Points, fictitious transactions were common. Although they still required paying taxes to the Immortal Sect, they allowed a single Magic Tool to generate Points for two separate transactions.

On the Immortal Sect Network Official Flagship Store, every so often, coveted Spiritual Pills and Magic Tools that enhanced the success rate of Foundation Establishment were released for competitive bidding, and these could only be obtained by redeeming Points.
Wu Wan had been planning for this for quite some time, accumulating Points.
This practice, akin to tax evasion in Diyuan Star's previous mechanical civilization, carried severe consequences. If caught, the Immortal Sect would confiscate all a cultivator's assets.

"Many people do this," Wu Wan said. "To maintain economic circulation, the Immortal Sect usually turns a blind eye. If the year-end tax revenue falls short and the higher-ups are displeased, they'll only target the wealthy elites. You have nothing to worry about."
"If you agree, I guarantee this Needle Case will fetch at least 80,000 Merit Points."

Seeing Chen Mobai's hesitation, Wu Wan upped the ante. Though he appeared young, Wu Wan was already 45. If he didn't attempt Foundation Establishment soon, his chances of success would dwindle with each passing year.

Next month, the Immortal Sect Network Official Flagship Store would release a batch of Meridian Guarding Pills, Spirit Raising Powder, and Qi Condensation Liquid—all spiritual medicines known to increase the odds of Foundation Establishment.
Wu Wan needed just 300,000 more Points to bid on one of these items.

Under normal circumstances, he wouldn't dare fabricate transactions to earn Points. But with the Dao within reach and his finances strained, he was willing to try any means necessary to acquire the necessary Points.
What if his luck turned and he successfully achieved Foundation Establishment?
"This Magic Tool has been passed down through generations," Chen Mobai replied. "If I'm to sell it, I must consult my family elders first."
Chen Mobai, being a good student, politely declined.
Wu Wan didn't press the matter further, merely wearing a look of regret. After all, he had only tried to take advantage of Chen Mobai's youth and see if he could trick him.
